**Position Title:**

**SEWP - Program Coordinator**

**Position Overview**

Golden Star Technology (GST) is seeking a detail-oriented SEWP Program Coordinator to support the daily operations of our NASA SEWP contract vehicle. This role is responsible for reviewing customer RFQs and bids, obtaining vendor pricing, and developing accurate quotes, proposals, and contract submissions for federal government customers.

The ideal candidate has experience in federal contracting, government procurement, proposal development, and inside or outside sales. Success in this role requires the ability to manage multiple opportunities simultaneously, collaborate with internal and external stakeholders, and deliver timely, compliant, and competitive responses in a fast-paced technology and public sector sales environment.

* Manage day-to-day activities supporting GST's NASA SEWP contract vehicle.
* Review customer **RFQs**, **RFPs**, **RFIs** and bid requests to ensure accurate, complete, and timely responses.
* Obtain and evaluate pricing, product availability, and lead times from OEMs, distributors, and vendor partners.
* Build, price, and submit accurate quotations, proposals, and supporting documentation for federal government customers.

* 3+ years of proven inside or outside sales experience, including direct customer engagement, quote generation, proposal development, and sales cycle management.
* Experience supporting federal government contracts, procurement, or acquisition programs.
* Experience preparing and managing quotes, proposals, bids, and RFQ responses.
* Strong understanding of government purchasing processes and contract compliance requirements.
* Experience working with OEMs, distributors, and vendor partners.
* Strong organizational, multitasking, and time management skills with exceptional attention to detail.
* Excellent written, verbal, and customer service communication skills.
* Proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite, including Excel.
* Ability to collaborate effectively across sales, procurement, contracts, finance, and vendor teams.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience supporting NASA Solutions for Enterprise-Wide Procurement **(SEWP)**, General Services Administration **(GSA)** Schedules, Government-Wide Acquisition Contracts **(GWACs),** Indefinite Delivery/Indefinite Quantity **(IDIQ)** contracts, or similar federal contract vehicles.

* Experience working with OEMs, distributors, and vendor pricing programs.
* Experience with **NetSuite, Salesforce,** or other **ERP, CRM, or quote management platforms**.
* Experience in the IT, technology, government contracting, or VAR industry.

**Compensation & Benefits:**

* Competitive salary
* Medical, dental, and vision coverage
* 401(k) plan
* Paid vacation
* Additional company perks

(GST)**, headquartered in Cerritos, California, has been recognized by the *Los Angeles Business Journal* as one of **LA's Best Places to Work** for seven consecutive years. jobs.description:
**About Abaka AI**

Abaka AI is built on one mission: to be the world's most trusted data partner for AI companies. More than 1,000 industry leaders across Generative AI, Embodied AI, and Automotive AI rely on us to power their data pipelines. With our headquarters in Silicon Valley—and teams in Paris, Singapore, and Tokyo—we support global partners with fast, reliable, and scalable data solutions.

Our offerings include a diverse catalog of off-the-shelf datasets—including image, video, multimodal, reasoning, and 3D data—as well as comprehensive data collection and annotation services. Whether teams need raw data, curated datasets, or full-cycle data engineering, Abaka AI provides the foundation for building high-performance AI systems.

**About the Role**

As the Event Marketing Associate, you'll help plan and run Abaka AI's events program, from leading AI and research conferences like NeurIPS, ICLR, CVPR, COLM, and SIGGRAPH to the customer dinners, happy hours, and community meetups we host ourselves.

Your main responsibilities will be managing event logistics, coordinating with vendors, keeping timelines and budgets on track, and working on-site to make sure every event goes smoothly. You'll also help drive attendance, capture leads, and put together post-event reports that measure the impact of each event on pipeline and brand awareness.

You'll work closely with our GTM Lead and with other teams, such as business development, engineering, and design, to understand their goals and build event experiences that support them. You'll have a designer to help with booth assets, signage, and event collateral. Design skills aren't required, but a keen eye for aesthetics is a plus.

To succeed in this role, you should be extremely organized, calm under pressure, and comfortable owning many details at once. You don't need to be an AI expert on day one, but you should be curious about the AI / LLM space and excited to learn it.

Our team is global, and you'll often coordinate events across time zones with colleagues in Paris, Singapore, and Tokyo. You should be able to adapt your communication style to work well with people from different backgrounds and cultures.

**Responsibilities**

* Plan and run logistics for Abaka AI's presence at leading AI and research conferences (e.g. NeurIPS, ICLR, CVPR, COLM, SIGGRAPH), including booth setup, international shipping, travel, and run-of-show.
* Organize hosted events such as customer dinners, happy hours, and community meetups, from venue sourcing to guest list to day-of execution.
* Manage vendors, including venues, booth builders, caterers, swag suppliers, and printers. Collect quotes, negotiate, and handle contracts and invoices.
* Build and maintain event timelines and budgets, and keep stakeholders updated on deadlines and spend.
* Work with business development and marketing to drive attendance through invite lists, registration pages on platforms like Luma, email invites, and social promotion.
* Work on-site at events: set up and tear down, staff the booth, check in guests, and solve problems as they come up.
* Capture and upload leads to the CRM (HubSpot or Salesforce) after each event, and report on attendance, pipeline, and ROI.
* Manage inventory of booth materials, signage, and branded merchandise, and work with our designer on new event assets.
* Research the AI events landscape and recommend which conferences and community events we should attend, sponsor, or host.

**Minimum Qualifications**

* 1–3 years of experience in event coordination, field marketing, hospitality, or a related role (relevant internships count). Experience at a B2B, SaaS, or AI company is a plus.
* Experience with booth logistics at large academic, research, or tech conferences.
* Strong organization and project management skills, with a track record of managing many moving pieces at once.
* Clear, friendly written and verbal communication with both internal teams and external vendors.
* Comfortable with budgets, spreadsheets, and basic reporting. Familiarity with event platforms and CRMs is a plus.

jobs.title: Customer Success & Deployment Leader
jobs.description:
### **About Noble Machines**

Noble Machines builds multipurpose robots to support human workers in the world's toughest jobs—turning dangerous work from a necessity into a choice. Our work demands reliability, robustness, and readiness for the unexpected—on time, every time. We're assembling a mission-driven team focused on delivering real impact in heavy industry, from construction and mining to energy. If you're driven to build rugged, reliable products that solve real-world problems, we'd love to talk.

### **Position Overview**

We're looking for an exceptional Customer Success & Deployment Leader to build and lead the organization that takes Noble Machines' general-purpose robots from signed contract to dependable, everyday operation at customer sites. This is a high-impact, high-ownership role: you'll own customer outcomes from the first pilot through fleet scale-up, renewal, and expansion, and you'll be the bridge between our customers and Noble Machines' engineering, autonomy, product, and service teams. You'll make sure our robots show up ready for the realities of construction, mining, and energy sites - and that they keep delivering value long after they arrive.

### **Responsibilities**

* Build the organization. Build and lead a team of deployment program managers, field and application engineers, and customer success managers, scaling the team and its leadership as Noble Machines grows.
* Own deployments end-to-end. Take full ownership from site assessment and task scoping through validation in Sunnyvale, on-site integration, commissioning, and hand-off to steady-state operations.
* Set deployment readiness standards. Define the safety, reliability, uptime, and performance criteria a robot must meet before it goes to a customer site—including readiness for dust, vibration, temperature extremes, and the unpredictable conditions of heavy-industry work.
* Run a repeatable playbook. Standardize how Noble Machines deploys: pilot-to-production gates, simulation and test validation, integration with customer site operations and safety programs, and change management and training for frontline crews working alongside our robots.
* Deliver and prove value. Track and report robot uptime, task throughput, time-to-productivity, intervention rate, hazardous-exposure hours removed from workers, customer satisfaction, and net revenue retention.
* Close the loop with engineering. Channel field data, failure modes, and customer requirements back to Noble Machines' engineering and product teams to shape the roadmap and improve reliability in the field.
* Manage executive relationships. Serve as the senior point of contact for customers' operations, safety, and site leadership; lead executive business reviews and own escalations.
* Work with partners. Coordinate with contractors, site operators, integrators, and service partners to keep deployments on schedule and on spec.

### **Requirements**

* 12+ years in customer success, professional services, field engineering, or deployment leadership, with at least 5 years in robotics, industrial automation, autonomous systems, or complex hardware-plus-software products.
* Proven experience moving robotic or autonomous hardware out of R&D and into commercial production at external customer sites.
* Experience building and leading distributed, field-based teams.
* Working knowledge of robot autonomy, simulation and sim-to-real validation, and industrial safety standards (e.g., ISO 10218, ISO/TS 15066, ANSI/A3 R15.06).
* Strong commercial sense, including renewals, expansion, services pricing, and deployment P&L.
* Executive presence and credibility with senior customer leaders, from site superintendents to the C-suite.
* Willingness to travel frequently to customer sites, including active construction, mining, and energy job sites.

### **Nice to Have**

* Direct experience deploying robots or autonomous equipment in construction, mining, energy, or other heavy-industry environments.
* Background in engineering or computer science; an MBA is a plus.
* Familiarity with jobsite safety programs and regulatory requirements (e.g., OSHA, MSHA).
* Experience scaling a customer-facing organization at an early-stage hardware company.

### **California Pay Transparency Statement**

Pay Transparency & Compensation: In accordance with California's Pay Transparency Act (SB 1162), the expected base salary range for this position located in Sunnyvale, CA is $230,000 - $300,000 per year.

  

Actual compensation within this range will be determined based on several factors, including the candidate's qualifications, relevant experience, technical skills, and specialized expertise. Base salary is just one component of Noble Machines' total rewards package, which may also include equity options, comprehensive healthcare benefits, retirement plan contributions, and performance-based incentives.

### **Equal Opportunity Employer**

Noble Machines is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. All employment decisions are based on business needs, job requirements, and individual qualifications, without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, veteran status, disability status, or any other status protected by applicable federal, state, or local laws.

Abaka AI is built on one mission: to be the world's most trusted data partner for AI companies. More than 1,000 industry leaders across Generative AI, Embodied AI, and Automotive AI rely on us to power their data pipelines. With our headquarters in Silicon Valley—and teams in Paris, Singapore, and Tokyo—we support global partners with fast, reliable, and scalable data solutions.

Our offerings include a diverse catalog of off-the-shelf datasets—including image, video, multimodal, reasoning, and 3D data—as well as comprehensive data collection and annotation services. Whether teams need raw data, curated datasets, or full-cycle data engineering, Abaka AI provides the foundation for building high-performance AI systems.

**About the Role**

As the Event Marketing Associate, you'll help plan and run Abaka AI's events program, from leading AI and research conferences like NeurIPS, ICLR, CVPR, COLM, and SIGGRAPH to the customer dinners, happy hours, and community meetups we host ourselves.

Your main responsibilities will be managing event logistics, coordinating with vendors, keeping timelines and budgets on track, and working on-site to make sure every event goes smoothly. You'll also help drive attendance, capture leads, and put together post-event reports that measure the impact of each event on pipeline and brand awareness.

You'll work closely with our GTM Lead and with other teams, such as business development, engineering, and design, to understand their goals and build event experiences that support them. You'll have a designer to help with booth assets, signage, and event collateral. Design skills aren't required, but a keen eye for aesthetics is a plus.

To succeed in this role, you should be extremely organized, calm under pressure, and comfortable owning many details at once. You don't need to be an AI expert on day one, but you should be curious about the AI / LLM space and excited to learn it.

Our team is global, and you'll often coordinate events across time zones with colleagues in Paris, Singapore, and Tokyo. You should be able to adapt your communication style to work well with people from different backgrounds and cultures.

**Responsibilities**

* Plan and run logistics for Abaka AI's presence at leading AI and research conferences (e.g. NeurIPS, ICLR, CVPR, COLM, SIGGRAPH), including booth setup, international shipping, travel, and run-of-show.
* Organize hosted events such as customer dinners, happy hours, and community meetups, from venue sourcing to guest list to day-of execution.
* Manage vendors, including venues, booth builders, caterers, swag suppliers, and printers. Collect quotes, negotiate, and handle contracts and invoices.
* Build and maintain event timelines and budgets, and keep stakeholders updated on deadlines and spend.
* Work with business development and marketing to drive attendance through invite lists, registration pages on platforms like Luma, email invites, and social promotion.
* Work on-site at events: set up and tear down, staff the booth, check in guests, and solve problems as they come up.
* Capture and upload leads to the CRM (HubSpot or Salesforce) after each event, and report on attendance, pipeline, and ROI.
* Manage inventory of booth materials, signage, and branded merchandise, and work with our designer on new event assets.
* Research the AI events landscape and recommend which conferences and community events we should attend, sponsor, or host.

**Minimum Qualifications**

* 1–3 years of experience in event coordination, field marketing, hospitality, or a related role (relevant internships count). Experience at a B2B, SaaS, or AI company is a plus.
* Experience with booth logistics at large academic, research, or tech conferences.
* Strong organization and project management skills, with a track record of managing many moving pieces at once.
* Clear, friendly written and verbal communication with both internal teams and external vendors.
* Comfortable with budgets, spreadsheets, and basic reporting. Familiarity with event platforms and CRMs is a plus.
* Basic design skills in Canva or Figma for quick event assets.
* A proactive, low-ego, "I'll handle it" attitude. Nothing is beneath you on event day.
* Ability to travel about 25–40%, including international travel to major conferences, and to work occasional evenings or weekends around events.
* Ability to build AI workflows and integrate tools such as Claude Cowork, Codex, and AI agents into your daily work.
* Curiosity about the AI research community and a desire to make a positive impact on the industry.
* Excited about working from our gorgeous Mountain View office
* Fluent / native in English. Proficiency in an additional language (e.g. French, Mandarin, Japanese) is a plus.

**Compensation & Benefits**

The base salary for this position is $70,000 - $90,000 USD annually. Compensation may vary depending on a number of factors, including a candidate's qualifications, skills, competencies, and experience. Base pay and variable compensation are part of the Total Package provided to compensate and recognize employees for their work at Abaka AI. This role is also eligible for equity, as well as a comprehensive benefits package (health, dental, vision, PTO, flexible work schedule).
